scope: Map theme names and cosmetic regional atmosphere

classic.name: 香榭花都
classic.atmosphere: warm spring/summer garden, cream petals and pollen

compact.name: 京都花见
compact.atmosphere: long spring, pink cherry crowns and fluttering petals

expansion.name: 曼哈顿大道
expansion.atmosphere: autumn showers, wet paths and peripheral city mist

harbor.name: 蔚蓝港湾
harbor.atmosphere: summer sea breeze and three-layer moving nearshore foam

alpine.name: 阿尔卑斯山镇
alpine.atmosphere: light snow, winter vegetation and low mountain mist

integration: Menu, map titles, building cards, collection links and historical labels use the new names
Stable map IDs, saved economic state and gameplay numbers retained
Automatic climate varies by map; manual season/weather controls still override
Marked perimeter plants follow seasons; structural materials and shaders remain unchanged
Accents use existing scene clock and never consume gameplay randomness
limitations: Phone-sized browser checks, not physical-device performance measurement
